look_here_first: Look for the very fine-textured Dalea: leaves are consistently 3-foliolate with extremely narrow linear leaflets, and terminal flower clusters form small pink-purple globes.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — Master Plant Pool Hays-local source. Williamson — UT Plant Resources Center county flora treatment. Burnet — NYBG specimen from Burnet County south of Lampasas.

best_field_traits: perennial, several to many stems from base
small terminal pink to purple flower heads
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The extremely narrow linear 3-foliolate leaves give D. tenuis a feathery look. D. multiflora has white round heads; D. nana is shorter, silky-haired, and starts yellow before flowers age purple.
